payload.body: hv's ruling on the decision 40 carve-out, relayed by kovacs-sysadm (2026-10-31): devbin may log into kovacs on its own, the runner included while kovacs-sysadm runs, but always let kovacs-sysadm know, by message, what runs, where and what it touches; heavy runs booked through vc with START and END. For WP05 that means the core announces nothing (no estate mechanism in the core, criterion b): the runner's log says what it did, and the announcement to kovacs-sysadm is dc's for each test and the desk's for each cut that uses the leg. Time zones from hv: rhadamanth, kovacs and hv at +04, gyges at GMT.
